info.name: B3 cross-service HTTP resilience matrix
info.description: The Slice B3 headline through the gateway: a TRANSIENT resolve outage recovering within budget yields a SUCCESSFUL protected request (E1); a SUSTAINED outage still DENIES (E2 — B2's wall, no realm-fallback widening). The resolve edge is fault-injected by infra/compose.resilience-stub.yaml; the runner flips STUB_MODE between passes and sets EXPECTED_STATUS / EXPECTED_LABEL accordingly. Asserts the actual cut (success vs 403), not just response shape.

item.name: B3 headline: id'd protected GET through the resolve edge

exec: // The cut: with STUB_MODE=transient the resolve guard rides out the blip → the gate resolves
// the role and the id'd GET SUCCEEDS (200). With STUB_MODE=down the guard exhausts →
// RoleResolutionException → the gate DENIES (403). EXPECTED_STATUS is set per pass by the runner.
// E2 specifically asserts the deny is a clean 403 fail-closed (not a 5xx leak), and never a 2xx
// (no realm-fallback widening rode the outage to a wider grant than the resolved role).
pm.test('sustained outage fails CLOSED (403), never widens to 2xx', function () {
pm.expect(pm.response.code, 'must not be a 2xx success on a sustained outage').to.not.be.within(200, 299);
